from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_hb import Session

INSTANCE = "/app/instance.npz"

def main():
    s = Session("package", instance=INSTANCE)

    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"approach": "initial standing pose hold"})
    print({"steps": len(actions), "state": s.replay(actions)})
